title: Knight Rider
description:

Garthe Knight leads Michael into a confrontation by kidnapping Devon, April and the scientist Michael was hired to protect.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S2 E19 — Goliath Returns
Michael (David Hasselhoff) and Christina (Suzanne Barnes) try to destroy Goliath and rescue Devon (Edward Mulhare), April (Rebecca Holden) and Dr. Bergstrom (Peter Mark Richman) from Garthe (David Hasselhoff in a dual role).

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:

The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E11 — Steel
A struggling contractor's (Norman Alden) warehouse-demolition site is sabotaged by a mob-hired competitor.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E12 — The White Ballot
Face becomes a candidate for sheriff to expose a small-town law officer's shady dealings. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E13 — The Maltese Cow
The team foils both an international dope deal and extortionists preying on a Chinese restaurateur (Keye Luke).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E14 — In Plane Sight
The team must flush a major cocaine trafficker out of Colombia to help a young woman clear her uncle of drug-smuggling.
